title: SCCM Task Sequence Troubleshooting & Status Message Analysis
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (diagnostic runbook + tooling for Configuration Manager OSD task-sequence failures: status messages, smsts.log, exit codes; conditional logic).
hook: Decode why the task sequence failed — read the status messages and smsts.log like an expert
problem: When a Configuration Manager task sequence fails during OS deployment, the answer is buried in status messages, exit codes, and a sprawling smsts.log — and a stalled build blocks the whole rollout while engineers guess. This solution is a structured way to troubleshoot SCCM task sequences and analyze status messages: read task-sequence states and status message IDs correctly, parse smsts.log to the failing step, map common exit codes to root cause, and resolve the failure classes (content, drivers, network, app install, reboot) fast.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — how task sequences report state, status message IDs and severities, where the logs live (smsts.log across phases), the failure classes, and the diagnose-then-resolve model.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Configuration Manager access, status message queries / the Monitoring workspace, log access on the client/WinPE, symbol/exit-code references) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: locate the failing task-sequence step via status messages, pull and read smsts.log for that phase, map the exit code to a cause, apply the fix per failure class, re-run, and capture the resolution, then pilot the runbook and expand.

5 PowerShell scripts — task-sequence + status-message discovery, deployment-state validation, a failure-summary and exit-code report, safe remediation helpers (retry/clean cache), and a scope/collection targeting helper.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: A structured way to troubleshoot SCCM task sequences and analyze status messages — read task-sequence states and status message IDs, parse smsts.log to the failing step, map exit codes to root cause, and resolve failures fast. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
